assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has reported persistent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The dizziness and giddiness have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to evaluate the correlation between symptomatic events and underlying arrhythmic activity
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I49.9, and R42
The service represents a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study as described by the payer
The appeal requests reconsideration of the PR-204 denial
The PR-204 denial indicated that this specific service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is medically necessary to correlate the patient's dizziness and giddiness with underlying arrhythmic activity
